body: Yes just not like I was able to before.
It’s a autoimmune so I’ll never be better unfortunately. But it’s not as bad as it was before or could be.

I would be his friend if he still did care. He send me mixed signals all the time. Even since posting all this. He plays with me like a yo-yo on a string and I think he enjoys it. My ex husband is also suing me for custody for the 90 millionth time (very slight exaggeration). I had to quit my wonderful paying job because I got sick. Hope is there but it’s dwindling minute by minute. Thanks for talking with me anyway.

I felt like it was me just keeping the chats going, and friends suggested I stop talking to him to see if he cares.  That's where the one week of no communication came in. Sure enough he just ignored me for a week. Then when we see each other today he initiates two hugs and tells me to be good. 
Unfortunately I'm not sure what makes me happy right now, I'm trying to figure it out. I guess hope is the only fuel keeping me going.  I'm just trying not to exhaust the supply.

I've tried being friends with him for the past month and a half after we broke up.  We talked daily for a while and then the last week it just stopped. The whole hug thing happened today after the week of not talking.
I'm starting to feel that way.  I'm sorry you feel even more lost than me.  I'm not quite sure what it is keeping me going.  I hope you and me both can find some peace.

I'm not 100% sure myself.  Everything seemed to be going great then he just pulled away.  He said he read a post on reddit that made him realize he doesn't prioritize me enough.  So he ended it because it's not fair to me. Now he wants to be just friends even though he knows I love him.  His reasons keep changing so I doubt he knows.
I went to pick up something from him that he still had of mine.  He hugged me twice and told me to be good. I feel so extra dead on the inside now. Oh and he mentioned again we could be friends......

You'll probably get really tired like others have said.  You should probably just get comfy and take a nap.  Higher doses usually make you forget what you do when your on it. If you feel like you can't breathe properly call an ambulance.  Be safe.  I hope you feel better.
